scripts.backend:setup: python3 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && backend/.venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && backend/.venv/bin/python backend/download_voice.py && backend/.venv/bin/python backend/download_whisper.py
scripts.start: npm run build && cross-env DAISY_SERVE_STATIC=1 backend/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n VITE,ELECTRON "cross-env DISABLE_HMR=false npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:3000 electron ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run backend:build && electron-builder
scripts.electron:pack: npm run build && npm run backend:build && electron-builder --dir
